name: Colt
source:
Colt has the most experience in hockey out of everyone, playing from almost the time since he learned how to walk. He's naturally gifted in offense along with towering over most of the other playes. He's also a bit of a flirt and will be the first to compliment Paige in anything she does. However, he's strangely easy to frazzle on and outside the rink, and he's always been a bit of a ball hog.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37386]Lemmasoftl[/url]]
